## What the controls already do well — carry this forward

- **First person, Chris talking.** Never brand voice, never "we at FundHub believe."
- **Short sentences. One idea each.** Line breaks do the pacing.
- **Name the cost before the fix.** Every ad spends real time on what the problem already took from
  them before it introduces the solution.
- **Absolution.** "That's not on you." The system failed them, not the other way around.
- **The refusal.** *"I know there are a lot of people in this space who will tell you whatever you
  want to hear to get you on a call. We're not going to do that."* That line is the voice.
- **Same close, every time.** No hard inquiry. No obligation. Nothing moves until you say so.

## What the controls are missing — this is the opening

- **The Conveyor Belt isn't in a single one of them.** Clean → apply → sweep the new inquiries →
  repeat, up to 12 rounds. It's the strongest mechanism FundHub has and it has never run.
- **Speed isn't quantified.** "Weeks not months" is vague. ~7 days against an industry 30–45 is a
  number.
- **The guarantee never appears.** 24-hour review, 72-hour submission, or no upfront fee.
- **No qualification gate.** Every control is wide open. None of them say who this isn't for.
- **One case study across all seven.** Koi Poke carries every ad.
